verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Amazing love
That welcomes me
The kindness of mercy
That bought with blood, wholeheartedly
My soul undeserving

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
God, You're so good
Oh God, You're so good
God, You're so good
You're so good to me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Behold the cross
Age to age
And hour by hour
The dead are raised, the sinner saved
The work of Your power

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I am blessed, I am called
I am healed, I am whole
I am saved in Jesus' name

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Highly favored, anointed
Filled with Your power
For the glory of Jesus' name

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
And should this life
Bring suffering
Lord, I will remember
What Calvary has bought for me
Both now and forever
